title: Best WhatsApp Business Platform for Brazil 2026: 8 BSPs Compared | Message Central Blog

facts.fact: The article states that platforms with managed onboarding handle Meta verification in 1 to 5 business days.
facts.quote: Platforms with managed onboarding handle Meta verification in 1 to 5 business days.

facts.fact: The article states that self-service platforms take 2 to 6 weeks for Meta verification, leaving the business to navigate Meta alone.
facts.quote: Self-service platforms leave you navigating Meta alone, taking 2 to 6 weeks.

facts.fact: The article's author claims that a platform without native Pix integration leaves 30 to 50 percent of conversion potential on the table; the page gives no source for this figure.
facts.quote: Platform without native Pix integration leaves 30 to 50 percent of conversion potential on the table.

facts.fact: WhatsAppNow (Message Central), per the vendor's own page text, offers managed onboarding in up to 5 business days.
facts.quote: managed onboarding in up to 5 business days

facts.fact: WhatsAppNow (Message Central) states it offers free test credits without requiring a credit card.
facts.quote: free test credits without credit card

facts.fact: WhatsAppNow (Message Central) states it provides 24x7 Portuguese support.
WhatsAppNow (Message Central) states its native Pix integration covers Banco do Brasil, Itau, Bradesco, Pagar.me, EBANX and Mercado Pago.
facts.quote: native Pix integration with major banks and PSPs (Banco do Brasil, Itau, Bradesco, Pagar.me, EBANX, Mercado Pago)

facts.fact: The article states that Zenvia is a Nasdaq-listed Brazilian company that is a Meta BSP.
The article states that Bird (formerly MessageBird) was rebranded in 2024.
facts.quote: Global BSP rebranded in 2024 with strong focus on conversational AI.

facts.fact: The article states that the WhatsAppNow product had a downtime of 15 minutes at the time the page was captured.
facts.quote: currently experiencing a downtime of 15 mins on our product
